title: spec: the object_extension registry row's comment says the artifact loader stores extensions under this type; it does not
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① Wanted 2 of #28834 (should-fix 3 of the PR #28811 contract review, record `6565271420`), carried to its own card by this seat. It is in `packages/spec/**`, so it goes to the spec lane, and the server half of #28834 lands without it. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p3 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01): a code comment that misstates the loader, with no behaviour.

Reach: a reader of `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`'s `object_extension` row.

## What it says

`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`, the comment above the `object_extension` row (about L819–L821), says: "A code package declares its extensions in `objectExtensions`, which the artifact loader already stores under this type name." It does not. The artifact loader stores no `(object_extension, name)` item. A manifest's `objectExtensions` registers through the `registerApp` extension loop in `objectql/src/engine.ts`, and only a stored row of this type is an item (#28574). The PR #28811 review read this at head `d05c1863`: `isSealedManagedItem` finds no artifact of the type.

## Wanted

The comment states what happens: a code package's `objectExtensions` register as `'extend'` contributors through `registerApp`, never stored as items of this type; this type's items are the stored rows the `/api/v1/meta` doors write. Comment only: no key, no row field, no schema change. A `skip-changeset` diff if nothing a package ships moves (judge by `files[]`).

Dedupe: searched `object_extension artifact loader stores`. **New.**

Links back: #28834, #28574, PR #28811 (record `6565271420`), ADR-0146 D10.
